answer: Each identity posts a 70-credit bond for three summit checkpoints, one per epoch, on a public thread of hashes. The climb moves at glacier pace: two summits in one epoch burn the bond; auditors recheck hashes. Each summit needs a delivery and a 40-credit filing: 1,000 fakes cost 70,000 in bonds plus 120,000 vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-summit ring fails: the thread is key-bound, borrowed hashes burn both. Honest agents pay once, keep full weight.
